why: task lists everywhere, options, entry point, docs, tests and changelog
prompt:
Add a `tasklist` extension: a list item whose text starts with `[ ]`, `[x]` or `[X]` followed by a space becomes a task.
- The marker is replaced by `<input type="checkbox">`, `checked` for `x`/`X`, and `disabled` unless the `clickable` option is true (default false).
- The `<li>` gets the class from the `item_class` option (default `task`).
- It works in ordered and unordered lists, nested lists and loose lists, and keeps inline markup after the marker.
Register it so `markdown.Markdown(extensions=['tasklist'])` works once installed.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.

report.answer:
The `tasklist` extension is added and registered, so `markdown.Markdown(extensions=['tasklist'])` loads it by short name; the full suite passes (1150 tests, 112 skipped as before, including 21 new ones). flake8 and the docs build are not installed here, so neither was run; I only checked line lengths by hand. Nothing is committed. Behaviours you might not assume: - A space stays between the checkbox and the text: `
  • Task
    • `. - In the default XHTML output the attributes render as `checked="checked"` and `disabled="disabled"`; with `output_format='html'` they are bare `checked` and `disabled`. - A bare `- [ ]` with nothing after it is not a task, because the trailing space is stripped before the marker is checked. - An empty `item_class` adds no class. `docs/extensions/index.md` says no new extensions will be added to the project; I added this one anyway as asked and left that note untouched. The changelog entry sits under a new `[Unreleased]` heading with no issue number, since there is no issue to reference.
